essence: Emotion is both her domain and the means by which she is approached and experienced.
She embodies sacred auspiciousness and actively brings fortune into manifestation.
Fortune is fully encompassed in her as its activity, substance, continuity, and gift.
She governs fortune from its perception and direction to its highest bestowal and origin.
She encompasses all relational roles that sustain and govern the sphere of brothers.
